g.title: G
g.text: Beaver's Choice Paper Company - Multi-Agent Workflow (smolagents, 5 agents)
Solid arrows = control flow between agents (labelled with the data passed). Dashed arrows = tool calls. Grey = starter helper functions used by each tool.

g.title: orch
g.text: Customer-facing. Decides the order of delegation;
never checks stock or sets prices itself.
Decision: assess -> quote (if anything can be supplied) ->

g.title: reply
g.text: total, delivery date, reasons for unfilled items

g.title: inv
g.text: Matches items to catalog, checks stock,
Decision: ship from stock / restock in time /

g.title: sal
g.text: Finalizes the quote and records the sale.
Decision: run a financial health check

g.title: adv
g.text: Runs once after the batch; reviews all

g.title: t_stock
g.text: purpose: units on hand for one item

g.title: t_snap
g.text: purpose: all stock + items below reorder point

g.title: t_cat
g.text: purpose: customer wording -> catalog item + price

g.title: t_eta
g.text: purpose: supplier lead time for a quantity
